title: Comparison Between Erythromycin and Neomycin Treatment of Hepatic Encephalopathy
brief_summary: Comparison between the efficacy of two different antibiotics in patients with overt hepatic encephalopathy. The study is randomized, controlled and double-blinded.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Hepatic cirrhosis or portal hypertension
* Hepatic Encephalopathy

Exclusion Criteria:

* Acute liver failure
* Neuropsychiatric diseases
* Inflammatory bowel diseases
* Intestinal obstruction
* Shock
* Renal insufficiency
* Alcoholic hepatitis
* Alcohol abuse
* Antibiotic premedication
